How much does interior painting cost?

Fresh paint through the whole house — or just a few rooms — what it costs, and what moves the price:

$350–$5,800
Interior painting, national — average about $2,022

National average $2,022 · about $2–$6 per sq ft

Bay Area: $1,340–$3,935 (avg $2,635) — older Victorians with ornate trim and tall ceilings push toward $4–$8 per sq ft.

What drives the price

Why quotes run $350 to $5,800

Four things move the price:

Square footage
The biggest lever: about $2–$6 per sq ft nationally. A 1,000-sq-ft home runs $2,000–$6,000; a 2,500-sq-ft home $5,000–$15,000.
Prep work
Patching, sanding, and priming beat-up walls takes longer than the painting itself. Budget for drywall repairs averaging $600.
Ceilings & trim
Walls alone average $2.75 per sq ft; adding trim and ceilings brings it to $4.70. Tall ceilings and archways add detail work.
Paint quality
A gallon covers 350–400 sq ft and runs $15–$60 standard, $50–$100 designer. Better paint covers in fewer coats.
Coverage

Walls only or the works

Walls only
$2.75 per sq ft

Just the walls, one or two colors. The cheapest way to make a room feel new.

Walls + trim + ceilings
$4.70 per sq ft

The full treatment — crisp trim and ceilings make the walls look twice as good for less than twice the price.

Bottom line: if the trim is already in decent shape, paint the walls and stop. Full trim and ceilings are worth it when you're selling or the woodwork is beat.

Questions

Common questions

How long does it take to paint a house interior?

A few days for a few rooms; one to two weeks for a whole house. Prep and dry time between coats set the pace, not the rolling.

How much paint do I need?

One gallon covers 350–400 square feet. Measure the walls, subtract big windows and doors, and buy 10% extra for touch-ups.

Should I paint the ceilings too?

Yes if they're stained or yellowed — dingy ceilings make fresh walls look unfinished. White ceiling paint is cheap; the labor is the cost.

DIY or hire a pro?

DIY saves the labor cost but takes weekends and shows every shortcut. Hire out tall ceilings, stairwells, and anything needing serious prep.

Every home prices differently.

The range above is a national average. Your price depends on square footage, prep work, and local labor rates. Take a photo of the rooms in Brightglow for an estimate on the actual space, and to compare local pros who've done the same work.
